flags.description: Settings changes (popup/settings switches) take effect immediately in all active tabs without page reload
Interceptor-first model detection — uses fetch interceptor slug over DOM-scraping for more reliable model identification
Core feature: monitors AI service usage, calculates energy consumption in Wh per request and persists daily totals
Automatically identifies active AI service (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, etc.) from URL and DOM
Real-time floating HUD card per request showing tokens in/out, energy (Wh), model name and XP delta with slide-in animation
Per-request token counting with service-specific strategies: exact tokenizer (ChatGPT), interceptor (Claude), DOM estimation (others)
Extension icon badge showing today's accumulated energy in Wh with color-coded severity levels
XP and level system with 10 levels, progress bar in popup, and achievement unlock toasts on AI pages
Hidden unlockable badges for specific user actions: Hintertür, Wissensdurst, Sieger sind eben Sieger
Optional prompt suffix for ChatGPT encouraging concise responses — reduces output tokens and improves XP score
Energy tracking for normal Google Search and Google AI Mode (udm=50) with configurable baseline models
Toggle to automatically append -ai filter to Google searches, routing queries away from AI Overview
Enable/disable tracking per service — standard services (Copilot, Claude, Google) and optional (DeepSeek, Grok, Meta, Poe, Mistral, GitHub Copilot)
Three calibrated energy models selectable in settings: Jegham (empirical), Altman (OpenAI estimate), Epoch (FLOP-based)
Power Usage Effectiveness factor toggle (hyperscale 1.09 / industry 1.56) to account for datacenter cooling overhead
Full-page dashboard with interactive weekly chart, day/week/month/year breakdowns, service table and CO2 comparisons
Multi-user team dashboard with configurable energy budgets, department tracking, company logo and race feature
Export personal usage data as CSV from the dashboard for external analysis and reporting
File System Access API (OPFS) for persistent historical data storage beyond chrome.storage.local limits — with write buffer and migration
First-run folder picker flow for File System Access consent — once completed, fully automatic thereafter
Tracks time spent per AI service per day, filtering out sessions under 2 seconds
Pauses active session timer when browser goes idle or screen locks, resumes on activity
Browser notification when daily energy exceeds 100 Wh threshold
Interactive 7-bar canvas chart in popup with hover tooltips, day click for breakdown, and period tabs (day/week/month)
Slide-in toast on AI pages showing detected service and model name with animated dots while waiting for interceptor response
Detects simple factual queries (what is, who is, capital of…) and suggests using Google Search instead to save energy
Show estimated water consumption (WUE) alongside energy stats — WUE_FACTOR defined but not yet wired into calculation or dashboard
flags.promote_notes: Wire WUE_FACTOR into calcWh() and display in HUD and dashboard before promoting
